For example, Greater(time.Now(), time.Time{}) or Less(time.Time{}, now) can give a wrong result because the nanosecond value is undefined. Use Before/After/Equal instead.

obj2 is converted to time without checking that it is convertible. If obj1 is a time.Time and obj2 is another struct or type, Convert panics instead of returning an error. For example, Greater(time.Now(), struct{}{}) panics. Elsewhere, a type mismatch is reported as a failed assertion.
